description: Defines a custom exception class 'CannotDeleteRoleWithChildrenException' which is thrown when attempting to delete a role that has child roles in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: CannotDeleteRoleWithChildrenException
classes.description: A custom exception extending APIException, indicating failure to delete a role with child roles.

methods.name: CannotDeleteRoleWithChildrenException
methods.description: Default constructor which initializes the exception with a default message indicating that roles with children cannot be deleted.

methods.name: CannotDeleteRoleWithChildrenException
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified for the exception.

methods.description: Constructor that allows chaining with a cause (another Throwable).

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with only a cause, without a custom message.
